content: If the function EthSwt_GetSwitchPortMode is called, the function shall check the access to the Ethernet Switch Driver. If the check fails, the function shall raise the extended production error ETHSWT_E_ACCESS and re- turn E_NOT_OK , otherwise pass the production error ETHSWT_E_ACCESS and return E_OK .
